channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula diz a Trump que Brasil não precisa de 'classificação' para combater crime organizado
item.description: Lula told Trump Brazil does not need an international designation to fight gangs like CV and PCC, as it has its own legal tools. Brazil opposed the US move, citing intervention risks. Trump agreed to strengthen bilateral cooperation on the issue.

item.title: Em conversa por telefone, Lula diz a Trump que alegações dos EUA para tarifaço são 'infundadas'
item.description: Lula and Trump had a friendly 1-hour-and-20-minute phone call. The Brazilian president dismissed U.S. justifications for tariffs as 'groundless' and emphasized preserving bilateral negotiations. Both leaders agreed to resume technical talks and discussed cooperation against organized crime.

item.title: Debate sobre 6x1 é populista e inócuo, diz coordenadora na campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Daniella Marques, head of the economic team for Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential campaign, labeled the debate over ending the 6x1 work schedule as populist and futile. Her remarks came on Friday (21), reinforcing the campaign's stance against popular working-hour reduction proposals.

item.title: Haddad volta a criticar Tarcísio e diz que ele está 'perdido' e 'não tem compromisso' com SP
item.description: PT's candidate for the governorship of São Paulo, Fernando Haddad, once again criticized his rival Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans), stating that he is 'lost' and 'has no commitment' to the state. The statement was made during a walk in downtown Mauá, in the ABC region of São Paulo, on Friday the 21st.

item.title: Caso Lulinha: PF só não chega a quem vazou se não quiser, diz jurista
item.description: Legal expert Pedro Serrano stated that the Federal Police has the means to identify who leaked selective information from the investigation involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, and would only fail to do so 'if they didn't want to.' His remarks, made on UOL News, have reignited debate over the control of leaks in sensitive inquiries.

item.title: Flávio discutirá cortes com Poderes se eleito, diz Daniella Marques
item.description: Daniella Marques, economic coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, stated that public spending cuts would require the participation of Congress and the Judiciary through a Superior Council of the Republic. She advocates for a digital administrative reform to reduce the number of public servants and criticized the size of the bureaucracy. The statements were made during the 25th Lide Business Forum in Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Nunes exige que aliados de Tarcísio levem o “22” de Flávio
item.description: Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB) publicly demands that candidates backed by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) include Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) number 22 in campaign materials, pressing for electoral alignment on the right in São Paulo.

item.title: "Vai acabar": Cleitinho insiste em promessa sobre IPVA apesar do STF
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos), a candidate for Minas Gerais governor, modified his pledge to end vehicle seizures over unpaid IPVA. Following legal criticism citing Supreme Court rulings, he now proposes a 30-day grace period for payment before impoundment, maintaining his promise that seizures will "end" starting January 1st.

item.title: TSE asfixia campanha de Marçal e expõe o papel das ‘candidaturas fantasia’ da ultradireita
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) unanimously banned Pablo Marçal from using electoral funds, participating in debates, or running free campaign ads, labeling his candidacy as an irregular simulation. The ruling followed a request from the Electoral Public Ministry, which found flaws in his party affiliation and exposed the use of 'phantom candidacies' by the far-right.

item.title: Família Batista, da JBS, compra 100% da Avibrás, fabricante de armas de guerra
item.description: J&F, the Batista family holding, acquired 100% of Avibrás, a Brazilian defense manufacturer, after years of crisis and judicial reorganization. The company, now named Avibras Aeroco, resumed production recently with government support.

item.title: A missão de Michelle que pode esvaziar sua participação em campanha por Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, running for the Senate in the Federal District, may have reduced involvement in Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign due to a strategic mission at the national level. She is seen as a key figure to strengthen the PL's bench in the Senate and advance the party's far-right wing in other races, prioritizing efforts to build a conservative majority in the chamber.

item.title: Crusoé: Marçal e o jogo da atenção
item.description: Businessman Pablo Marçal (PRTB) announced his support for Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential bid in 2026 during a stage event. He stated that Flávio is the true heir of the Bolsonaro legacy and criticized the PT and Lula, advocating for a political alternative.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula, quatro ministros do STF e uma garrafa de uísque
item.description: President Lula held an informal meeting with four STF ministers, including Alexandre de Moraes, in an encounter involving whiskey, as reported by O Globo. The event highlights the informal tone of Executive-Judiciary relations, sparking discussions on institutional independence and transparency.

item.title: Perito diz que Dark Horse não é página virada para a PF
item.description: Expert in the Dark Horse case admits gaps in spending compatibility analysis and reveals PF requested detailed operational costs. In the Lulinha case, the Supreme Court ordered a leak investigation protecting journalists, and the PGR stated no closed deals were found between the government and the 'INSS Bald Man'. The PL will have explicit platforms for Flávio Bolsonaro in only three Northeastern states.

item.title: Coordenadora de plano econômico de Flávio critica proposta de fim da jornada 6x1
item.description: Daniella Marques, economic plan coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro, criticized the proposal to end the 6x1 work schedule as populist and ineffective, advocating for freedom of direct negotiation between workers and employers without state interference. She argues reducing work hours would increase costs for producers, while the Lula administration supports a constitutional amendment to cut the workweek from 44 to 40 hours with two days off.

item.title: Bolsonaristas apelam ao Congresso para amplificar caso Lulinha como desgaste para Lula na eleição
item.description: Senator Carlos Viana (PSD-MG) filed a request to create a parliamentary inquiry (CPMI) into alleged private interest mediation by Lulinha, President Lula's son. The initiative, backed by Bolsonaro supporters, aims to amplify the case as political leverage against Lula early in the 2026 election campaign. The proposal requires 27 senatorial and 171 congressional signatures to proceed.

item.title: Daniella Marques sugere substituição de carreiras pelo uso de IA e corte de até 18 ministérios
item.description: Daniella Marques, economic coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign, proposed cutting up to 18 ministries and reassessing public careers due to AI advancement, advocating for an amendment to end reelection and streamlining state-owned enterprises.

item.title: Carlos Bolsonaro critica Judiciário e imprensa ao comentar investigação contra Lulinha
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro criticized the Judiciary and the press regarding the investigation into Lulinha, alleging selective moderation and unequal persecution. He suggested Lulinha is involved in INSS irregularities, while claiming Bolsonaro and his sons would face severe judicial measures in a similar situation.

item.title: Em Nova Iguaçu (RJ), Flávio volta a atribuir endividamento a Lula e repete aceno a mulheres
item.description: In Nova Iguaçu (RJ), presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) repeated his pledge to combat household debt and maintain the Bolsa Família program in a potential government. He once again criticized the PT, blaming President Lula for family indebtedness and claiming Brazil must defeat the PT to avoid being defeated itself.

item.title: Debate sobre fim da escala 6x1 é 'populista e inócuo', diz coordenadora econômica de Flávio
item.description: Daniella Marques, coordinator of the economic agenda for Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) government plan, called the debate over ending the 6x1 work scale 'populist' and 'ineffective.' She advocated for greater freedom for workers and employers to negotiate work schedules.

item.title: Sob Duda Lima, Flávio Bolsonaro afina discurso e encontra rumo para sua campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro restructures his presidential campaign with three pillars defined by Duda Lima: legitimate heir of anti-PT sentiment, "necessary evil" for center-right to defeat Lula, and ethical attacks on the PT government. The strategy aims to counter Gilberto Kassab's assessment that he would be a weak second-round candidate.

item.title: Entre os vazamentos e as respostas, o dilema da campanha de Lula com Lulinha
item.description: Lula's campaign now treats the Lulinha case as an electoral variable, not just a legal one. Successive leaks create a damaging narrative faster than the official investigation can respond, and Lula defends both investigating the leak sources and having his son testify to the Federal Police. The opposition is already using the issue to request a Congressional Inquiry Committee (CPMI).

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vai a Nova Iguaçu com Ruas; no mesmo horário, 18 vereadores fazem ato com Paes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Douglas Ruas (PL) held a rally in Nova Iguaçu, while 18 councilors supported Eduardo Paes (PSD) and Pedro Paulo (PSD) in the same city. The race highlights the fragmentation of Bolsonarismo in the Baixada Fluminense, as municipal leaders shift support toward PT-linked candidates. Nova Iguaçu and Duque de Caxias are key battlegrounds for political influence.

item.title: Lobista pagou cartão e carro de ex-chefe de gabinete de Lula enquanto negociava com governo, diz PF
item.description: A Federal Police investigation reveals that lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger paid R$ 217,000 in credit card bills, car financing, and other expenses for Marco Aurélio Ribeiro (Marcola), former chief of staff to Lula, while negotiating with the government.

item.title: Eleição está mais apertada do que parece
item.description: The 2026 election is tighter than polls suggest, as biased sampling methods and voter abstention inflate Lula's lead. Face-to-face surveys underrepresent high-income, right-leaning voters, while averaging across institutes helps correct these distortions.

item.title: Flávio quer rediscutir gasolina com 32% de etanol
item.description: Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated he intends to renegotiate the mandatory 32% ethanol blend in gasoline, criticizing the recently approved measure by the CNPE due to potential engine damage and lack of durability testing. He compared the increase in ethanol content to the practice of reducing product sizes without price changes, claiming the government is 'not even sparing fuel.' The blend increase was established by the Fuel of the Future Law, signed in October 2024.

item.title: Lobista planejava tirar Lulinha do país no início de 2025
item.description: Investigations reveal that lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger planned to help Lulinha leave Brazil in January 2025, before the INSS scandal, to advance a R$1 billion-plus cannabidiol medication deal with Careca do INSS. Lulinha moved to Madrid in June 2025, two months after the massive INSS fraud erupted, living in a luxury condo rented for about €5,000. The Federal Police is investigating influence peddling by the pair within the Ministry of Health.

item.title: Mendonça manda PF investigar vazamentos do caso Lulinha
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça ordered the Federal Police to investigate the leaks and breaches of evidence custody in the investigations involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, the eldest son of President Lula. The decision was issued on Thursday (August 20, 2026) and aims to determine responsibility for the leaks in the case.

item.title: Defesa de Lulinha celebra decisão do STF, mas vê prejuízo consolidado
item.description: The defense of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, celebrated the decision by Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça ordering the Federal Police to investigate the leak of confidential data regarding the businessman. Lawyer Marco Aurélio de Carvalho welcomed the opening of inquiries to probe the selective and out-of-context disclosure of the audio recordings, but lamented that the damage to his client's image is already consolidated. Mendonça ordered the identification of those who had access to the confidential material, preserving secrecy and ruling out investigations against journalists.

item.title: Questão sobre grávida morta pelo ex gera revolta em concurso do MPSP
item.description: Candidates for the MPSP job exam protested the classification of a case in which a pregnant woman was killed by her ex-boyfriend as qualified homicide rather than femicide. The exam board justified the decision, arguing there was no indication of gender-based prejudice, but the answer key was challenged by roughly 150 applicants. The case sparked debate over the proper application of the femicide statute in Brazilian law.

item.title: O pedido de Thalis Bolzan após separação de Eduardo Leite e mudança para SP
item.description: After separating from Eduardo Leite, Thalis Bolzan moved to São Paulo and used social media to ask locals for help finding available tennis courts. He posted a photo holding a racket and humorously requested suggestions in the Pinheiros, Jardins, and Itaim neighborhoods, noting it couldn't be during 'heir time'.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro diz ao STF que veto acabou e quer retomar visitas
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's defense told the STF that the 30-day period suspending visits to the former president under house arrest has ended, notifying the resumption of appointments. Visits were suspended by Minister Alexandre de Moraes on July 17 after determining that Bolsonaro violated house arrest restrictions. The minister must authorize the meetings, while Flávio Bolsonaro remains barred from visiting his father until October.

item.title: Passados 30 dias de ordem de Moraes, defesa de Bolsonaro informa ao STF que retomará agendamento de visitas 'gerais'
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's defense team announced to the STF that general visits to the former president will resume after the 30-day ban imposed by Minister Moraes expired. Medical, physiotherapy, and legal team visits were already allowed, but politically motivated visits remain prohibited until the end of the 2026 elections.

item.title: O cálculo da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro diante dos novos fatos envolvendo Lulinha
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro believe the investigation into Lulinha could damage Lula's campaign, but fear a retaliatory offensive with false accusations to neutralize the political impact. The case creates uncertainty about political developments in the coming weeks.

item.title: ‘Pelo presidente Lula, teríamos acabado com as bets’, diz ministro
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan defended the regulation of sports betting ('bets') and blamed the lack of prior rules on the Temer and Bolsonaro administrations. Durigan stated that President Lula and himself would prefer to ban bets entirely, but chose a strict regulatory path instead, comparing it to tobacco control. Recent measures have blocked access for 5 million CPFs, including social welfare beneficiaries and 'Desenrola' debtors, plus 1.2 million voluntary self-exclusions.

item.title: Lula divide palanque com fiscal suspeito de aumentar o próprio salário
item.description: President Lula publicly supports the gubernatorial candidate for Rio Grande do Norte, Cadu Xavier, despite an ongoing investigation by the Ministry of Public Accounts into alleged irregularities in a salary increase for tax auditors during his tenure as Finance Secretary. The case questions the legality of the measure, potential breach of the Fiscal Responsibility Law, and a financial impact of R$ 13.1 billion on state coffers.

item.title: Equipe econômica vai levar a Lula possibilidade de aporte nos Correios ainda este ano
item.description: The economic team will present President Lula with the possibility of injecting at least R$ 6 billion into the Correios this year, as outlined in a R$ 12 billion loan agreement with banks. The capitalization is part of the deal and must be completed by the end of next year.

item.title: Lulinha quer retirar do ar vídeo de Flávio Bolsonaro que o associa a escândalo do INSS
item.description: Lulinha sued Flávio Bolsonaro over an AI-generated video linking him to the INSS scandal, demanding its removal and R$10,000 in moral damages. The lawsuit argues that while the video is clearly fictional, the underlying accusation of stealing from elderly people is false and defamatory.

item.title: 'Quem são os candidatos': g1 lança ferramenta com dados oficiais de candidaturas e campanhas
item.description: g1 launched the 'Quem são os candidatos' tool, which aggregates official TSE data on candidacies and campaigns for the 2026 elections. The platform allows searches by name, party, gender, occupation, and other filters, and displays detailed information about each politician, including declared assets and campaign finances.

item.title: Novo Datafolha hoje: saiba o horário da divulgação da pesquisa sobre disputa Lula x Flávio
item.description: New Datafolha poll to be released at 6:40 PM this Friday (21), testing Pablo Marçal (PRTB) in presidential scenarios for the first time. The survey includes spontaneous and stimulated voting intention, four runoff simulations with Lula against Flávio Bolsonaro, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema and Renan Santos, plus rejection rates, government approval and state races in SP, RJ, MG, PE and DF. 2,058 interviews conducted Aug 18-20, with 2-point margin of error.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro amplia equipe econômica com 7 novos nomes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) expanded his economic team with 7 new experts from public and academic sectors to develop technical proposals for his campaign platform. Led by Daniella Marques and Adolfo Sachsida, the group aims to address high interest rates, public debt and fiscal challenges.

item.title: Defesa de Lulinha usa mesmo argumento de Moro para questionar revelações de VEJA
item.description: Lulinha's defense challenges the authenticity of messages published by VEJA, arguing that the chain of custody and evidence integrity cannot be verified. They draw a parallel to the arguments used by Sergio Moro and Deltan Dallagnol during the 'Vaza Jato' scandal. The defense maintains that there is no evidence of corruption or misuse of public funds and requests the dismissal of the investigations.

item.title: Lula mira cidade de MG onde teve derrota dura para Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula visits Governador Valadares, where he suffered a heavy defeat against Bolsonaro in 2022, to announce R$ 309 million in federal investments. The move aims to strengthen the PT's presence in Minas Gerais, a state decided by only 40,000 votes, while Flávio Bolsonaro seeks to inherit his father's electorate.

item.title: Equipe de Flávio pega credenciais para debate da Band
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's team requested credentials for the Band debate, but he is unlikely to attend unless Lula also participates. Without both, the debate is expected to include only three candidates: Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, and Renan Santos.

item.title: Relação com Trump: Brasil quer evitar nova escalada na crise diplomática
item.description: The Lula administration maintains a conciliatory stance toward Trump, prioritizing avoiding renewed diplomatic crisis and pursuing a pragmatic relationship without requiring political alignment.

item.title: Mendonça determina investigação contra vazamentos no caso Lulinha
item.description: Minister André Mendonça ordered the Federal Police to investigate leaks of confidential information from the inquiries involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, following a request from the defense. The investigation will proceed as part of an ongoing inquiry related to the Operation Without Discount, which examines fraud at the INSS, targeting non-journalists who disclosed protected data.

item.title: Comissão do governo Lula garante bolada de R$ 100 mil a ex-deputado do PT
item.description: The Lula government's Amnesty Commission recognized Vicentinho, former PT lawmaker, as a political amnestee and granted him R$100,000 in a one-time payment, after overturning a decision made under the Bolsonaro administration. The ruling, issued in May, also annulled rejections for eight other applicants and included an official apology for persecution during the dictatorship. Changes in the commission's composition under the previous government had led to the rejection of many amnesty requests.

item.title: Atuação de Lulinha em negociações com governo foi encoberta por amiga lobista e ‘Careca do INSS’, diz PF
item.description: Federal police are investigating alleged irregular negotiations involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, aided by lobbyist friend Roberta Luchsinger and the 'Bald INSS' lobbyist. Messages suggest Lulinha's involvement was concealed to secure contracts in the Ministry of Health and other public agencies.

item.title: Tarciana Medeiros enfrenta pressão interna no Banco do Brasil
item.description: Tarciana Medeiros, president of Banco do Brasil, faces internal pressure following criticism over agricultural risk management. Allies label the accusations as 'gossip' in an election year. Internal divisions emerge regarding her leadership.

item.title: Mendonça manda PF apurar vazamentos envolvendo Lulinha
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça ordered the Federal Police to investigate leaks of information related to investigations against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula. The businessman is under three inquiries for suspected influence trafficking. The decision aims to investigate irregularities in the disclosure of sensitive data about the case.
